points.title: 登基与宗教改革
points.description: 血腥玛丽在1533年登基成为英格兰女王。在她的统治下，英格兰进行了宗教改革，她支持亨利八世的离婚，并宣布英格兰教会脱离罗马天主教。此外，她开始对异端进行镇压，特别是对那些支持罗马天主教的人。这一时期，她开始对异端进行审判和处决，这成为她统治时期的一个特点。
points.descriptionEn: Mary I ascended to the throne in 1533. Under her reign, England underwent religious reform, supporting Henry VIII's divorce and declaring the English Church independent from the Roman Catholic Church. She also began to suppress heretics, particularly those supporting Roman Catholicism, marking a key aspect of her rule.

points.title: 异端审判与处决
points.description: 血腥玛丽在位期间，对异端进行了大规模的审判和处决。她认为这些异端威胁到了她的统治和宗教信仰。在她的统治下，至少有300人被处决，其中许多人被烧死在火刑柱上。这一时期被称为‘血腥玛丽’的统治时期。
points.descriptionEn: During Mary's reign, there was a massive campaign of heresy trials and executions. She believed these heretics threatened her rule and religious faith. Under her rule, at least 300 people were executed, many of whom were burned at the stake. This period is known as the 'Bloody Mary' reign.

points.title: 统治结束与逝世
points.description: 1553年，血腥玛丽在位期间结束，她去世后，伊丽莎白一世继位。她的统治以对异端的残酷镇压而闻名，尽管她在位时间不长，但她的统治对英格兰历史产生了深远的影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1553, Mary's reign came to an end with her death, and Elizabeth I succeeded her. Her reign is known for its harsh suppression of heretics, although her time in power was short, it had a profound impact on English history.

points.title: 温莎城堡的统治
points.description: 血腥玛丽在温莎城堡度过了她的晚年。她在那里继续她的宗教政策，并准备对抗苏格兰的入侵。她的统治在温莎城堡的这段时期，也见证了她的健康状况逐渐恶化。
points.descriptionEn: Mary spent her later years at Windsor Castle. She continued her religious policies there and prepared for a possible Scottish invasion. Her reign at Windsor Castle also witnessed the gradual decline of her health.

points.title: 伊丽莎白一世的继位
points.description: 血腥玛丽的去世标志着她的统治结束，伊丽莎白一世继位。伊丽莎白一世的统治开启了英格兰的黄金时代，而血腥玛丽的统治则因其对异端的残酷镇压而闻名。
points.descriptionEn: Mary's death marked the end of her reign, and Elizabeth I succeeded her. Elizabeth's reign opened the Golden Age of England, while Mary's reign is known for its harsh suppression of heretics.

supporter.zh: 支持者认为血腥玛丽是一位坚定的天主教徒，她致力于恢复天主教的权威，并保护英格兰不受新教的侵蚀。她的统治被视为对英格兰文化和宗教传统的维护。
supporter.en: Supporters view Mary I as a steadfast Catholic who was dedicated to restoring the authority of the Catholic Church and protecting England from Protestant infiltration. Her reign is seen as a defense of English culture and religious traditions.

critic.zh: 批评者认为血腥玛丽的统治充满了对异端的残酷镇压，她的宗教政策导致了大量无辜者的死亡。她的统治被视为暴政和宗教迫害的象征。
critic.en: Critics argue that Mary I's reign was marked by the cruel suppression of heretics, leading to the deaths of many innocent people. Her rule is seen as a symbol of tyranny and religious persecution.

objective.zh: 客观历史视角认为，血腥玛丽是一个复杂的历史人物。她的统治在宗教和政治上都有重要影响，尽管她的宗教政策导致了大量的死亡，但她也是英格兰历史上的一个重要女王，对英格兰的文化和宗教传统产生了深远的影响。
objective.en: An objective historical perspective views Mary I as a complex historical figure. Her reign had significant religious and political impacts, although her religious policies led to many deaths, she was also an important queen in English history, profoundly influencing English culture and religious traditions.

self.zh: 我愿意为我的信仰而死，但我不愿意看到我的国家因为我而分裂。
self.en: I would rather die for my faith than see my country divided because of me.

others.zh: 她是一位坚定的天主教徒，她的统治充满了对异端的残酷镇压。
others.en: She was a steadfast Catholic, and her reign was marked by the cruel suppression of heretics.
